stories.story_fr: MGM Resorts a enregistré des revenus nets consolidés record de 4,5 milliards de dollars au premier trimestre 2026, en hausse de 4 % d’une année sur l’autre.
stories.story_en: MGM Resorts reported record consolidated net revenues of $4.5 billion in Q1 2026, up 4 % YoY.
stories.quote: record 1Q consolidated net revenues of $4.5 billion, an increase of 4% compared to the prior year quarter

stories.story_fr: La cession des activités de MGM Northfield Park pour 546 millions de dollars renforce la liquidité de l’entreprise.
stories.story_en: The sale of MGM Northfield Park operations for $546 million strengthens the company's liquidity.
stories.quote: sale of the operations of MGM Northfield Park for $546 million

stories.story_fr: Le BetMGM North America Venture a versé 135 millions de dollars à MGM Resorts au quatrième trimestre 2025.
stories.story_en: BetMGM North America Venture distributed $135 million to MGM Resorts in Q4 2025.
stories.quote: BetMGM North America Venture distributed $135 million to MGM Resorts during 4Q25

stories.story_fr: MGM a racheté 15 millions d’actions au quatrième trimestre 2025, réduisant le nombre d’actions en circulation de 48 % depuis 2021.
stories.story_en: MGM repurchased 15 million shares in Q4 2025, cutting shares outstanding by 48 % since 2021.
stories.quote: Repurchased 15 million shares in 4Q25 and 37.5 million in 2025, reducing shares outstanding by 48% since the beginning of 2021

stories.story_fr: MGM China a atteint une part de marché record de 16,6 % au deuxième trimestre 2025.
stories.story_en: MGM China achieved a record market share of 16.6 % in Q2 2025.
